text: To get home, they needed the Moon's gravity. But Apollo thirteen had left its safe, free-return path, to aim for its landing site. So they fired Aquarius's descent engine, built to land on the Moon, to put them back on a path that would swing around the Moon and fall back toward Earth. Behind the Moon, they flew farther from Earth than any humans had ever been. After the Moon, another burn sped them up, to get home sooner.
